name: chin-up-gironda-sternum
title: Chin-Up (Gironda Sternum)
primer: This is an exercise for lats, biceps, and middle back strengthening, which is similar to the basic chin up but focuses more on lats.
steps: Grasp the pull up bar with a shoulder width underhand grip.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended.
As you pull yourself towards the bar, lean your head back as far as you can and arch your spine.
Continue pulling so that your collarbone passes the bar and you are able to touch your sternum to the bar.
Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
tips: Ensure you contract your core and back muscles throughout this exercise in order to prevent injury and maximize the effectiveness of this exercise.
